KeyVault._comment: Production only. Set via an App Service application setting / env var — never a committed value. Empty = Key Vault integration is skipped entirely (see Program.cs).

Gdpr._comment: Automated retention purge (docs/rgpd-classification-donnees.md §2/§5, ADR-0012). RunRetentionPurgeInProcess defaults to false on purpose -- only the Azure App Service (via a Terraform app setting on the api app_service module) should ever set it to true. AWS runs the equivalent job as a Lambda instead (modules/aws/secret-rotation), so it must stay false there.
